0022600192.text: The Washington Wizards (4-5, 8th in the East, 1.5 games back in the Southeast) visit the Oklahoma City Thunder (7-2, 1st in the Northwest, 3rd in the West) for their 10th game of the season, having lost their last two while Oklahoma City has won three straight and is 4-0 at home. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins, Justin Champagnie, Reece Beekman and Tristan Vukcevic, and Anthony Davis is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision, while Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace, Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Jaylin Williams and Thomas Sorber. The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Wizards lost both games, most recently 132-111 in Washington on March 21, 2026.
